name: oracle-ai-data-platform-workbench-snowflake-migrator
description: Migrate a Snowflake database to Oracle AI Data Platform with a fixed, auditable runbook. Provisions a migration workspace and cluster, registers the Snowflake database as an EXTERNAL catalog and creates the INTERNAL target catalog, discovers the estate with an in-AIDP workflow, translates types and names into a reviewed plan, creates the target schemas and empty Delta tables on AIDP compute, and registers one copy job per schema (INSERT-SELECT, verified by row counts) for the customer to run. Inventories what is not a table or a view, security posture and table-maintenance state, and presents the data-movement options without choosing for you. Read-only against Snowflake, dry-run by default against AIDP, every create read back; teardown releases the compute or removes everything the migration created.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate a Snowflake database to Oracle AIDP with a fixed, auditable runbook.
interface.longDescription: Migrate a Snowflake database to Oracle AI Data Platform through a fixed twelve-step runbook: a migration workspace and cluster, the Snowflake database registered as an EXTERNAL catalog and an INTERNAL target catalog, in-AIDP discovery through the Snowflake connector, a reviewed type-and-name translation plan, target schemas and empty Delta tables created on AIDP compute, and one verified copy job per schema (INSERT-SELECT, row counts, optional decimal sums). Read-only against Snowflake and dry-run by default against AIDP; teardown releases the compute or removes everything the migration created.
defaultPrompt: Use snowflake-migrator-bootstrap to set up the migration config and verify both the Snowflake and the AIDP ends.
Use snowflake-migrator-overview to migrate a Snowflake database to AIDP, step by step through the S1-S12 runbook.
Use snowflake-migrator-demo to run the whole pipeline against an emulated estate, with no credentials.
